detail: HATVP declaration of patrimony (22 October 2025) records no direct financial participations in the capital of a company (heading 4: Neant) and no shares in real-estate civil companies (SCI) (heading 2: Neant). His non-remunerated leadership roles are in associations/public bodies (cemetery and geothermal syndicates, CCAS, Caisse des ecoles, Comite de bassin d'emploi Sud 94, associations 'Plus belle L'Hay' and 'Ile de France Rassemblee'), not commercial companies.
